versions.content: The function Fr_GetWakeupRxStatus shall perform the following tasks on FlexRay CC Fr_CtrIdx: 1. Read the wakeup pattern received indicators for channel A and channel B and write it to the output parameter Fr_WakeupRxStatusPtr. The value of *Fr_WakeupRxStatusPtr is bitcoded with the following meaning (Bit 0 = LSB, Bit 7 = MSB): Bit 0: Wakeup pattern received on channel A (1), otherwise (0) Bit 1: Wakeup pattern received on channel B (1), otherwise (0) Bit 2: Not used (always 0) Bit 3: Not used (always 0) Bit 4: Not used (always 0) Bit 5: Not used (always 0) Bit 6: Not used (always 0) Bit 7: Not used (always 0) 2. Reset the wakeup received indication status information within the FlexRay controller. 3. Return E_OK.
